statements.attributed: introduced up to five cations to occupy the same Wyckoff position of the same crystal structure, yielding the Mg0.2Co0.2Ni0.2Cu0.2Zn0.2O compound with the rock-salt structure
statements.quote: The high-entropy concept has been first applied to nanostructured alloys and, more recently, also to other systems, like oxides, where up to five cations can be introduced to occupy the same Wyckoff position of the same crystal structure, thus increasing Sconfig. The pioneering system was an equimolar solid solution of MgO, CoO, NiO, CuO, and ZnO, yielding the Mg0.2Co0.2Ni0.2Cu0.2Zn0.2O compound with the rock-salt structure, labeled in the following as TM-HEO, transition-metal high-entropy oxide.

statements.attributed: gave Mx(Co0.2Cu0.2Mg0.2Ni0.2Zn0.2)OFx by charge-compensating F– or Cl– with a monovalent cation M+ such as Li+ or Na+
statements.quote: The presence of F– or Cl– must be charge-compensated by a monovalent cation M+, as Li+ or Na+, to give Mx(Co0.2Cu0.2Mg0.2Ni0.2Zn0.2)OFx.

statements.attributed: found that entropy stabilization positively affects the capacity retention of the multicomponent oxide
statements.quote: In principle, it was found that entropy stabilization positively affects the capacity retention of the multicomponent oxide,, leading to increased cycling stability than the individual MO. Indeed, high process reversibility and long-term cyclability over 900 cycles with a specific capacity higher than 650 mAh g–1 were observed in half-cells including conventional liquid electrolytes and microsized HEO as an anode.

statements.quote: Based on XRD, TEM, and electron diffraction, Sarkar and co-workers recently proposed a lithiation mechanism that significantly differs from the conventional conversion reaction. In that study, it was shown that during the lithiation step, some cations (like Co2+ and Cu2+) are reduced to the corresponding metals.

statements.attributed: showed that the presence of the rock-salt structure throughout the conversion mechanism is evident only by SAED
statements.quote: The presence of the rock-salt structure throughout the conversion mechanism is evident, in fact, only by SAED. However, this is not definitive proof that such a structure could be specifically referred to HEO rather than a single binary oxide such as MgO, CoO, or NiO, all of them having the same rock-salt crystal structure.

statements.attributed: concluded that in the conversion reaction of TM-HEO, Mg2+ ions contribute to stabilize the phase, whereas the other cations, Co2+, Ni2+, Zn2+, and Cu2+, are responsible for the reversible capacity
statements.quote: In summary, it was concluded that in the conversion reaction of TM-HEO, Mg2+ ions contribute to stabilize the phase, whereas the other cations, Co2+, Ni2+, Zn2+, and Cu2+, are responsible for the reversible capacity.

statements.quote: The spectra show impressive similarities for all of the four cations (see below for experimental details) and appear extremely similar to those reported by Rost et al.
